store.hubFaqA5: There is no service commission on top of your amount — 0%. Our margin is in the conversion rate, and the total to pay is shown in advance.
store.hubFaqQ6: Is topping up by ID safe?
store.hubFaqA6: Yes. Only your public player ID or login is needed; you never share a password. Check that the ID is correct before paying.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using yupay you agree to these terms. yupay is an independent digital top-up service and is not affiliated with Valve, Tencent, Riot, miHoYo or other rights holders.

sections.p: yupay resells digital goods: in-game currency, wallet top-ups and subscriptions. Credit is delivered to the public ID or account you provide — we never ask for your account password.
Orders are placed without signup. Pay by card, Click, Payme or Uzum. The price is locked at payment time; you see the net amount to be credited before you pay.
Most orders are fulfilled automatically. You are responsible for the accuracy of the ID and account details; a credit sent to a wrong ID is non-refundable.
yupay is not responsible for bans or restrictions imposed by game platforms. The service is provided "as is".

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect the minimum data needed to fulfil your order and never sell it to third parties.

sections.p: Email (for the receipt and order status), the game ID or account identifier, and payment data. Card details are handled by the payment provider — we do not store them.
Only to fulfil the order, provide support and send the receipt. We do not share data for advertising.
Data is shared with suppliers and payment services only to the extent needed to fulfil the order.
You can request deletion of your data by contacting support.
The site uses technical cookies for the interface and basic analytics.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.intro: Refunds on digital goods are limited by their nature.

sections.p: If an order was not fulfilled (goods not credited) and cannot be fulfilled, we refund the money or credit it to your yupay wallet.

sections.h: When a refund is not possible
sections.p: After a successful credit, or if the ID or account were entered incorrectly through your own fault.
We decide on a request within 24 hours. A refund to the original payment method follows the payment provider's timelines.
Contact support on Telegram and include your order number.
